source: Star Citizen Wiki API (api.star-citizen.wiki); base_rs/tier curated in signatures.json

ores.name: Quantainium
ores.notes: Degrades after extraction. Highest value ore.

ores.name: Hadanite
ores.notes: Hand-minable gem (FPS scanner). All FPS gems share a flat 3000 signature in SC 4.8, so RS gives quantity, not which gem.

ores.name: Dolivine
ores.notes: Hand-minable gem (FPS scanner). Flat 3000 FPS signature in SC 4.8.

ores.name: Aphorite
ores.notes: Hand-minable gem (FPS scanner). Flat 3000 FPS signature in SC 4.8.

ores.name: Janalite
ores.notes: Hand-minable gem (FPS scanner), added in SC 4.8. Flat 3000 FPS signature.

ores.name: Beradom
ores.notes: Ground-vehicle (ROC/ATLS) deposit. Flat 4000 signature; shares the base with the I-Type asteroid and the other ROC deposits, so a 4000xn read is ambiguous between them.

ores.name: Salvage Panel
ores.notes: Salvageable ship panel. Also the 'Debris' asteroid signature (2000).

ores.name: I-Type Asteroid
ores.notes: Asteroid type signature. Shares the 4000 base with the ground-vehicle (ROC) deposits (Beradom/Feynmaline/Glacosite), so a 4000xn read is ambiguous between them.
